title: B40 v1.1 protocol: sole structural contract
description: All wire roots carry schemaVersion=1; nested objects do not. Every object is closed and all listed properties required. JSON duplicate keys must be rejected before schema validation. Domain and concurrency invariants in contract-draft.md also apply.

Time.description: RFC3339 profile: no leap seconds; explicit Z or offset at most 14:00; calendar date must be valid.

MoneyInput.description: CNY yuan, at most two fractional digits. 15 integer digits is storage representability, not a business amount limit.
